zh.title: 花为什么五颜六色？
zh.intro: 先找颜色的来源，再看看颜色怎样改变，最后发现花瓣上隐藏的信号。
titles: 花瓣里面，藏着不同的色素
同样有色素，为什么还会变色？
花开放时，细胞里的环境也在变
我们看见的颜色，不是全部
bridges: 先比较不同玫瑰的色素组合。下一站保持“色素”这条线索，看看绣球的显色还需要什么。
绣球不能只看土壤酸度。下一站走进牵牛花，区分土壤环境与花瓣细胞内部的变化。
这是同一朵花开放的过程，不是给它换土。下一站看看：同一朵花，在不同光线观察下还藏着什么。
颜色不仅让人觉得美，也可能帮助传粉者辨认和寻找花中的资源。回到第一站，想想不同色素还会吸收哪些光。
notes: 红粉色玫瑰常含较多花青素；黄色常与类胡萝卜素有关，橙色可有两者共同贡献。白花的可见着色色素较少，组织散射光使它看起来明亮；白色不等于完全没有任何色素。这里是在比较不同品种，并不是让同一朵花瞬间换色。
这里限定为三色牵牛“天蓝”（Ipomoea tricolor ‘Heavenly Blue’）。花瓣展开时，液泡内部酸性减弱，已有花青素的显色随之由偏红转蓝；不是用蓝色颜料替换红色颜料。拖动可同时观察花形与细胞环境。
向日葵外圈的舌状花常呈黄色，但其基部可积累吸收紫外线的黄酮醇，构成靶心状花纹。切换观察方式，花朵本身没有变色。研究发现这些花纹与传粉者偏好有关，也与环境适应有关；不是花朵有意识地画路标。
limits: 花朵、细胞与色素符号不在同一比例；颗粒数量只表示相对趋势，不是实测浓度。花青素画在液泡中，类胡萝卜素画在有色体中。
开放进度和颜色为定性插值，不是钟表时间、精确 pH 或所有牵牛花的通用规律。这里不提供调土或浇药的建议。
紫色覆盖表示紫外吸收较强，并不是蜜蜂眼中真实的紫色。图案为教学示意，各植株的范围会不同；向日葵花盘由许多小花组成。

en.title: Why are flowers so colorful?
en.intro: Find where color comes from, discover how it changes, then reveal the signals hidden in petals.
titles: Pigments are only part of the story
Cell conditions change as a flower opens
Visible color is not the whole picture
bridges: Compare pigment combinations in roses. Next, keep pigments in mind and discover what else hydrangeas need to develop their colors.
Soil acidity alone cannot explain hydrangea color. Next, distinguish soil conditions from changes inside morning-glory petal cells.
This is one flower opening, not a change of soil. Next, discover what the same flower reveals under a different way of viewing light.
Colors can help pollinators recognize flowers and find resources. Return to pigments and consider which kinds of light they absorb.
notes: Red and pink roses often contain more anthocyanins; yellow commonly involves carotenoids, while orange can involve both. White petals contain less visible coloring pigment and scatter light; white does not mean entirely pigment-free. These are comparisons between cultivars, not an instant recoloring of one flower.

This case is specifically Ipomoea tricolor ‘Heavenly Blue’. As petals unfold, their vacuoles become less acidic and existing anthocyanins shift from reddish to blue coloration. Blue paint does not replace red paint. Drag to inspect flower shape and cell conditions together.

Sunflower ligules often look yellow, but their bases can accumulate UV-absorbing flavonols, making a bullseye pattern. Changing the view does not recolor the flower itself. Research links these patterns with pollinator preferences and environmental adaptation; flowers do not consciously draw signposts.
limits: Flowers, cells and pigment symbols use different scales. Particle counts show relative trends, not measured concentrations. Anthocyanins are shown in vacuoles; carotenoids in chromoplasts.
Opening and hue are qualitative interpolations, not clock time, exact pH or a rule for every morning glory. This is not soil-treatment or chemical-watering advice.
Purple overlays indicate stronger UV absorption, not the actual purple a bee sees. The pattern is illustrative and varies among plants; a sunflower head contains many small flowers.
